Artifacts.Name: Module Topics
Artifacts.Description: A structured outline of all topics and subtopics covered in this module — from defining topics and subtopics through generating, reviewing, editing, and understanding their downstream impact — used by instructors to understand the module's full scope and by learners as a navigation reference.

Artifacts.Name: Introduction to Module Topics and Subtopics
Artifacts.Description: An explanatory lesson defining module topics and subtopics, why they serve as the foundational architectural blueprint of an e-learning module, and how learners and instructional designers should think about structure before building any other content.

Artifacts.Name: How PreseMaker Analyzes Source Materials
Artifacts.Description: An explanatory lesson describing how PreseMaker ingests uploaded source materials, identifies key themes and concepts within them, and converts that raw content into a structured list of topics and subtopics before generating any slides or assessments.

Artifacts.Name: Generating the Module Topics List
Artifacts.Description: A procedural lesson walking learners through how to navigate to PreseMaker's topic generation feature, trigger the generation process, and understand what the system produces so they can use the resulting topics list as the foundation for their module.

Artifacts.Name: Browsing and Reviewing Generated Topics
Artifacts.Description: A procedural lesson explaining how to browse and review the Module Topics list PreseMaker produces after analysis, so learners can assess its accuracy and completeness before proceeding to build downstream content.

Artifacts.Name: Editing and Refining Topics and Subtopics
Artifacts.Description: A procedural lesson covering how to edit, add, remove, and refine the AI-generated topics and subtopics in PreseMaker, emphasizing the role of subject-matter expertise and instructional judgment in improving the initial automated output.

Artifacts.Name: Impact of Topic Structure on Downstream Content
Artifacts.Description: An explanatory lesson describing how the finalized topic and subtopic structure in PreseMaker directly drives the generation of all downstream content — including slides, speaker notes, knowledge checks, and summaries — so learners understand why getting the outline right matters.
